Yes, that's right! **Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only**, so your replacement would go out on one of those days. If your order also had non-living items, they ship together with the plant on a plant shipping day.

- A **weather hold** of up to 7 days is possible if transit forecasts are below 35°F or above 95°F. We'd email you if that happened.
- Your replacement can only be arranged once the courier investigation (up to **5 business days**) confirms the parcel is lost. I can't promise an exact ship date until then.
- I'll still ask a Support Lead about **Express** for your replacement, but I can't promise the answer.

To get the investigation started, I just need your **order number** (LF- followed by six digits). You'll find it in "My Orders" or your confirmation email. Your **$15 store credit** for the delay is still available too.

Thanks for your patience, and please reach out any time!
